messages:
maria: quick q — i'm seeing a terraform plan that wants to add an annotation to the serviceAccount in the payments helm chart: `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-payments-sa`

maria: i thought we were using IRSA via the oidc provider + eksctl-managed role binding, not hard-annotating in helm values. did someone intentionally add this? :thinking:

aj: i opened the chart changes — the subchart `payments-worker` adds `serviceAccount.annotations` in values.yaml. looks like a copy-paste from older infra terraform module. plan shows it replacing the existing SA.

kevin: hmm that annotation will make terraform try to manage the iam role binding vs the k8s controller. could break the existing TF resource that manages the IAM Role and the IAM OIDC trust. :eyes:

maria: exactly — i want to avoid two sources of truth. if the helm chart owns the annotation but TF also manages the role, we end up with drift and potential terraform tainting on next apply.

aj: suggested fix: remove the explicit annotation from the chart and instead template a value `extraAnnotations: {{ .Values.extraAnnotations | default dict }}` so we only inject it from the helm release via our infra pipeline when needed.

maria: good call. can we also make sure the serviceAccount name is stable? currently chart uses autogenerated names: `fullname: {{ template "payments.fullname" . }}` which can change across releases. we should set `serviceAccount.name` explicitly in values for infra-managed installs.

kevin: +1. also check the terraform aws_iam_role_policy_attachment resources — they reference the role by name string from tf state; if helm creates a role annotation with a different role ARN we'll break attachments.

aj: i'll send a tiny PR to payments chart removing hardcoded `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` and add `serviceAccount.extraAnnotations` with a note in values.yaml. will also send a follow-up PR to infra terraform to inject the annotation via helm_release values in the module.

maria: thanks. can someone review the tf change? @tess can you skim when aj posts? it touches the helm_release values in `modules/k8s/helm-release-payments` — mainly adding `serviceAccount.extraAnnotations = { "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = aws_iam_role.payments.arn }`

tess: yep i'll take a look. couple of things to watch for in the plan: 1) ensure we don't recreate the k8s serviceaccount, 2) make sure the iam role remains unchanged, 3) verify OIDC thumbprint/trust not impacted.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: remember to run `terraform plan -target=module.k8s.module.helm_release_payments` and `helm template ./charts/payments --values=values-prod.yaml` to confirm rendered SA annotations.

maria: i'll wait for aj's PR. if we still see plan diffs after that, we'll rollback the chart change and instead pass annotation via arg in the infra pipeline config. thanks all :thumbsup:
